topics.title_hint: Prompt hacks die fast. Harnesses compound.
topics.target_reader: AI product managers, growth operators, and technical founders
core_claims: Prompt quality is a system problem, not a writing trick.
Without a harness, teams cannot reproduce wins or debug failures.
The team that ships checklists and feedback loops beats the team with clever prompts.

topics.title_hint: If you cannot measure your agent loop, you cannot improve it.
topics.target_reader: AI product managers, growth operators, and technical founders
core_claims: Most teams over-index on generation quality and under-invest in operator metrics.
A weekly scorecard aligns product, growth, and engineering around reproducible outcomes.
Simple operational metrics outperform model hype when prioritizing agent improvements.
